title: Polished Nickel Towel Ring, 6-Inch Diameter, Wall-Mounted Solid Brass With Concealed Screws, Allied Brass
description: Bathroom towel ring, 6 inches diameter (6-inch, 6 in) wall mount / wall-mounted towel holder for hand towels and decorative towels in Polished Nickel, which offers a softer, warmer alternative to chrome with a subtle golden undertone that suits transitional spaces. Solid brass construction with a contemporary round shape and 2-inch projection; product size 6in L x 6in H x 6in W. Concealed screw mounting hardware creates a clean, finished appearance and helps save space compared with countertop storage. Includes the towel ring plus all installation hardware; no assembly required. Supports up to 10 lb. Use as a hand towel ring, bathroom towel ring, or wall mount towel ring next to a vanity or sink. Limited lifetime warranty. Coordinate with matching Foxtrot pieces from the Foxtrot collection for designer bathroom hardware, designer bath accessories, and statement bath accessories by Allied Brass Foxtrot.
